2. Advanced analysis
--------------------

The following examples use MAPIE for discussing more complex MAPIE classification problems.

.. raw:: html

    <div class="sphx-glr-thumbcontainer" tooltip="In this tutorial, we estimate the impact of the training/conformalization split on the prediction sets and on the resulting coverage estimated by SplitConformalClassifier. We then adopt a cross-validation approach in which the conformity scores of all conformalization sets are used to estimate the quantile. We demonstrate that this second &quot;cross-conformal&quot; approach gives more robust prediction sets with accurate conformity plots.">

.. only:: html

  .. image:: /examples_classification/2-advanced-analysis/images/thumb/sphx_glr_plot_crossconformal_thumb.png
